title: PaymentWebhookRequest
description: JSON-RPC params for the mock payment webhook. V1 procedures auto-call the handler in-process; tests and a future Stripe HTTP adapter call it explicitly. Event names mirror Stripe stages with unambiguous mock names (e.g. payment_intent.capture_succeeded vs Stripe's payment_intent.succeeded after manual capture). Payload uses payment_intent_id as the correlation key for every transaction row of a payment.

payment_intent_id.description: The payment_provider_transaction_id from the intent row; ties every lifecycle row together.
